name: RRCL Site Purchase Requisition By Item and Site
query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(t1.rrcl_name, t2.rrcl_name) AS rrcl_name,
    COALESCE(t1.work_site, t2.work_site) AS work_site,
    IFNULL(t1.ordered, 0) AS ordered,
    IFNULL(t2.delivered, 0) AS delivered
FROM
    (
        -- Subquery for ORDERED items (from Purchase Requisitions)
        SELECT
            item.rrcl_name,
            pr.work_site,
            pri.item AS item_code,
            SUM(pri.qty) AS ordered
        FROM
            `tabRRCL Purchase Requisition Item` AS pri
        LEFT JOIN
            `tabRRCL Purchase Requisition` AS pr ON pri.parent = pr.name
        LEFT JOIN
            `tabRRCL Item` AS item ON pri.item = item.name
        GROUP BY
            pri.item, pr.work_site
    ) AS t1
LEFT JOIN
    (
        -- Subquery for DELIVERED items (from Stock Entries)
        SELECT
            item.rrcl_name,
            se.work_site,
            sei.item AS item_code,
            SUM(sei.qty) AS delivered
        FROM
            `tabRRCL Stock Entry Item` AS sei
        LEFT JOIN
            `tabRRCL Stock Entry` AS se ON sei.parent = se.name
        LEFT JOIN
            `tabRRCL Item` AS item ON sei.item = item.name -- Need item name here too
        GROUP BY
            sei.item, se.work_site
    ) AS t2
    ON t1.item_code = t2.item_code AND t1.work_site = t2.work_site

UNION ALL

SELECT
    t2.rrcl_name AS rrcl_name,
    t2.work_site AS work_site,
    IFNULL(t1.ordered, 0) AS ordered,
    IFNULL(t2.delivered, 0) AS delivered
FROM
    (
        -- Subquery for ORDERED items (from Purchase Requisitions)
        SELECT
            item.rrcl_name,
            pr.work_site,
            pri.item AS item_code,
            SUM(pri.qty) AS ordered
        FROM
            `tabRRCL Purchase Requisition Item` AS pri
        LEFT JOIN
            `tabRRCL Purchase Requisition` AS pr ON pri.parent = pr.name
        LEFT JOIN
            `tabRRCL Item` AS item ON pri.item = item.name
        GROUP BY
            pri.item, pr.work_site
    ) AS t1
RIGHT JOIN
    (
        -- Subquery for DELIVERED items (from Stock Entries)
        SELECT
            item.rrcl_name,
            se.work_site,
            sei.item AS item_code,
            SUM(sei.qty) AS delivered
        FROM
            `tabRRCL Stock Entry Item` AS sei
        LEFT JOIN
            `tabRRCL Stock Entry` AS se ON sei.parent = se.name
        LEFT JOIN
            `tabRRCL Item` AS item ON sei.item = item.name
        GROUP BY
            sei.item, se.work_site
    ) AS t2
    ON t1.item_code = t2.item_code AND t1.work_site = t2.work_site
WHERE
    t1.item_code IS NULL; -- Only include rows that were NOT matched in the LEFT JOIN above
report_name: RRCL Site Purchase Requisition By Item and Site
